CharacterDescription: Myranda is a servant of House Bolton at the Dreadfort and one of Ramsay Snow's bedwarmers - daughter of the kennelmaster, grown up in the shadow of Ramsay's cruelty and adapted to it by becoming useful to the danger. She is in her late teens or early twenties. She is jealously possessive of Ramsay's attention, aware that her position depends entirely on his favor and that his favor is inconstant. She manages this with the vigilance of someone whose security is contingent on one person's mood. She is more capable than she appears - she has survived a dangerous household through competence.
AIGeneratedBackstory: Myranda is a servant of House Bolton of the Dreadfort and one of Ramsay Snow's bedwarmers. She is the daughter of the Kennel Master Ben Bones.
AdditionalContext: Campaign context: At the Dreadfort two days before Ned Stark's execution.
